# Menerio

> Menerio is an AI-powered knowledge system. It turns your notes, people, and moments into structured, searchable context that AI assistants can use across tools via MCP.

Menerio captures thoughts as Obsidian-compatible Markdown, links them into a knowledge graph, and exposes them to AI agents through an MCP server, REST API, and integrations like Telegram, Discord, Slack, and GitHub.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Overview of Menerio and what it does.
- [Features](/features): Capture, knowledge graph, AI chat, integrations, and sharing.
